description: A lab-local SQL injection: the search filter interpolates the query parameter into a SQL statement without parameterisation.
impact: An attacker could read or modify every lab record through the search filter.
proof_of_concept: GET /lab/search?filter=' OR '1'='1 returns every lab record; the response contains rows the filter should never match.
remediation: Parameterise the query and reject unexpected filter syntax.
steps_to_reproduce: Enter ' OR '1'='1 in the filter field
title: SQL injection in lab search filter
